LanguageData.MouseDisaster_Gene_MoreLitter.label: Large Litters
LanguageData.MouseDisaster_Gene_MoreLitter.descriptio: Each birth produces at least four offspring, with a chance of further births and no fixed upper limit.
LanguageData.MouseDisaster_Gene_MoreLitter.customEffe: Further offspring may be born, with no fixed upper limit
LanguageData.MouseDisaster_Gene_PrimalFertility.label: Early Maturity
LanguageData.MouseDisaster_Gene_PrimalFertility.descr: Allows pregnancy before the usual life stage. Both parents must still be at least one biological year old.
LanguageData.MouseDisaster_Gene_PrimalFertility.custo: Pregnancy can occur before the usual life stage
Both parents must be at least 1 biological year old
LanguageData.MouseDisaster_Gene_HyperBreeding.label: Hyperfertility
LanguageData.MouseDisaster_Gene_HyperBreeding.descrip: The carrier's chance of pregnancy is increased to 300% of its usual value.
LanguageData.MouseDisaster_Gene_ChaosFertility.label: Chaos Fertility
LanguageData.MouseDisaster_Gene_ChaosFertility.descri: A carrier sharing an indoor room with a compatible male of the same status may become pregnant, including while lactating. Both must be at least one biological year old. The interval and chance can be adjusted in settings (2% per check by default).
LanguageData.MouseDisaster_Gene_ChaosFertility.custom: Chance of pregnancy while sharing a room with a compatible partner
Both parents must be at least 1 biological year old
Chance can be adjusted in settings (2% by default)
Interval can be adjusted in settings
LanguageData.MouseDisaster_Gene_MoreComing.label: Rapid Gestation
LanguageData.MouseDisaster_Gene_MoreComing.descriptio: The carrier's pregnancy lasts a fixed twelve days, unaffected by other gestation speed changes.
